evidence_items.explanation: Executed Python improved localization substantially but worsened tracking; the study attributes significant errors to generated algorithms and optimization inaccuracies. This supports the limited claim that adding Python does not assure dependable solutions.

Preliminary demonstrations found successful Hanoi solutions when models generated Lua functions. This cautions against treating puzzle-output failures as proof that code generation cannot help, but it concerns another language and later tests.
